content: Laravel 12 requires PHP 8.2+. Standard project setup uses 'composer create-project laravel/laravel'. Projects include Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, and Livewire 3 by default. SESSION_DRIVER=database and CACHE_STORE=database work out of the box. Database migrations are the standard way to define schema. Laravel's auth scaffolding is modular - no longer bundled in framework. Rate limiting uses RateLimiter facade with configurable attempts and decay.
